desc:
Welcome to Monsters vs 99 Players! 👹

👹 THE MONSTER: You're a giant backrooms monster. Smash walls, grab, throw and EAT every player before the timer runs out!
🔫 THE PLAYERS: Team up, open fire and take the monster down, but be careful, it wants to EAT YOU!

⚡ Short, chaotic rounds: a whole server of players vs 1 monster, and 2 monsters on big servers!
😱 Play as Verity, the Huntress, the Boiled One, Siren Head and the Lurker.
💵 Earn cash to unlock OP guns and new monsters!
🔁 Want to be the monster? Every round someone new gets picked!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a thumbs-up, it helps a lot!
